title: BloomAura Touch Night Light — Rechargeable RGB Lamp
body_html:
Touch it once. Any mood, any color, instantly.

The BloomAura Touch Night Light turns any room into exactly the vibe you want — tap the top to switch between colors, dim it down for bedtime, or grab the remote from across the room without getting up.

No cords, no fuss. A full charge runs 6-7 hours cordless, so it goes wherever you need it — nightstand, nursery, living room shelf.

Free shipping on every order.

Why people love it

  • Touch-activated — no fumbling for switches in the dark
  • 16 RGB colors + warm white, dimmable
  • Rechargeable via USB-C, lasts 6-7 hours per charge
  • Remote control included for across-the-room adjustments
  • Makes a genuinely great gift

Specifications

  • Material: ABS plastic
  • Power: USB-C rechargeable, 1200mAh battery
  • Certification: CE, EMC, RoHS
